_meta.title: Qwen3.5-9B encoder (~9 GB) - type MUST be moss_image
FLUX.2 VAE (also encodes the character reference)
4-STEP SPEED LoRA - REQUIRED at steps:4. Do not replace it with the edit LoRA; chain them (4 -> 21).
Negative - inert at cfg 1.0 (only the positive is evaluated). Matters if you raise cfg for the 50-step recipe.
Latent 1024x1024 (MOSS-Image is trained square; portrait ratios are weaker). Must match node 20's scale target.
4-step / cfg 1.0 / euler+simple = the GPU-verified recipe. Only valid because node 4 supplies the speed LoRA. Official quality recipe: drop node 4, 50 steps, cfg 3, sgm_uniform.
Character reference - ST substitutes "%char_avatar%" with bare base64. PERCENT SIGNS ARE MANDATORY and the token must be the whole value.
Reference-conditioned positive. images.* is a v3 Autogrow input (min 1, max 10): in API format each slot is a FLAT DOTTED KEY images.image_N, not a nested dict.
MANDATORY pre-scale - TextEncodeMOSSImageEdit uses references at the size they arrive and its VAE-encode dies on a tiny ST avatar.
EDIT LoRA - what makes the reference image actually bind. Chained AFTER the speed LoRA.

inputs.string_a: Using the provided reference image as the single source of truth for this character's identity: keep their exact face shape, features, hair colour and style, eye colour, skin tone and build unchanged. Treat the reference as the character; only the pose, framing, expression, clothing, lighting and setting described below may differ. Do not invent a different person who merely resembles them.

_meta.title: Edit instruction + scene. string_a is what makes the prompt REFERENCE the image; string_b must stay exactly "%prompt%" (ST only substitutes a standalone quoted value). Put any LoRA trigger token at the START of string_a.
